sentences.text: Amaze Entertainment was a video game developer from the United States that developed over 100 games in its ten-year history -LRB- selling nearly 40 million units -RRB- , for several video game platforms , with headquarters located in Kirkland , Washington .	video game developer	video game developer	United States	United States
Amaze was founded by serial entrepreneur Dan Elenbaas and his business partners Todd Gilbertsen and David Mann .	serial entrepreneur	entrepreneurship
Amaze 's primary focus was licensed games based on movie franchises , comic series , and original titles for established video game franchises .
Amaze grew to become one of the world 's largest independent video game developers , with nearly 300 employees in four studios .
Amaze was acquired by Foundation 9 Entertainment on November 14 , 2006 .	Foundation 9 Entertainment	Foundation 9 Entertainment
In July 2009 , Foundation 9 abandoned the Amaze Entertainment brand and renamed the Kirkland location after the former subsidiary , Griptonite Games .	Griptonite Games	Griptonite Games
On August 2 , 2011 , Glu Mobile acquired Griptonite Games .	Griptonite Games	Griptonite Games	Glu Mobile	Glu Mobile
Its staff of 200 `` approximately doubles '' Glu 's internal development capacity .
